title: 9Round vs Flex Fitness
meta_desc: Compare 9Round and Flex Fitness Auckland NZ prices, contracts, facilities, and value to choose the best gym for your needs and budget.
intro: 9Round and Flex Fitness Auckland NZ offer distinct gym experiences. 9Round is a boutique gym with kickboxing-focused group fitness, while Flex Fitness provides budget-friendly 24/7 access. We compare these gyms to help you decide which one suits your lifestyle and preferences.

sections.heading: Overview of 9Round and Flex Fitness
sections.body: 9Round is a boutique gym with a unique kickboxing-focused group fitness programme. It features 9 kickboxing stations, personal training, and an app. The gym has no lock-in contracts and no joining fee, with prices starting from $24.99 to $34.99 per week. On the other hand, Flex Fitness is a budget gym offering 24/7 access, personal training, and no lock-in contracts, with prices ranging from $10 to $18 per week.
list: 9Round: kickboxing-focused group fitness, personal training, app, no lock-in contracts
Flex Fitness: 24/7 access, personal training, no lock-in contracts, budget-friendly

sections.heading: Comparison of Key Features
sections.body: To make an informed decision, it's essential to compare the key features of 9Round and Flex Fitness. The following table highlights their differences in price, contract length, cancellation, facilities, locations, and 24/7 access.

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Considering the unique features and pricing of each gym, we recommend 9Round for those seeking a boutique, kickboxing-focused experience with personal training and no lock-in contracts. Flex Fitness is ideal for budget-conscious individuals who prioritize 24/7 access and multiple locations. Additionally, eligible members can explore Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, offering 40-70% off gym memberships.
list: 9Round: suitable for busy individuals, cardio seekers, and stress relief
Flex Fitness: suitable for budget gym-goers, those who train at odd hours
